results.content: # KISTERS Field Sample Management. best-in-class Esri & KISTERS solution to collect, manage & report environmental field data & sample results. ## streamline data from field data collection to publishing. results.title: A partitioned conditioned Latin hypercube sampling method considering spatial heterogeneity in digital soil mapping | Scientific Reports
results.content:
Title: A partitioned conditioned Latin hypercube sampling method considering spatial heterogeneity in digital soil mapping | Scientific Reports
# A partitioned conditioned Latin hypercube sampling method considering spatial heterogeneity in digital soil mapping. While sampling methods based on environmental variables are widely used, the spatial heterogeneity of soil properties poses challenges by introducing variability in influential driving factors across subregions, potentially reducing prediction accuracy. A case study on SOC sampling in northeastern France demonstrated that PcLHS consistently outperformed traditional sampling methods, achieving lower root mean square error (RMSE, 0.40–0.43), higher coefficient of determination (R2, 0.36–0.44), and improved concordance correlation coefficient (CCC, 0.58–0.63). These results highlight the necessity of considering spatial heterogeneity in soil sampling design and establish PcLHS as an effective method for SOC prediction in heterogeneous landscapes. Initially, soil sampling method serves as a blueprint for gathering representative samples across the study area, ensuring reliable input for constructing predictive models that incorporate environmental variables19."). However, existing environment variables assisted sampling methods, including cLHS, generally assume that the effects of soil-forming factors on SOC are uniform throughout the study area, failing to capture subtle differences in spatial variability58."). To partition spatially heterogeneous areas into relatively homogeneous subregions, various methods have been explored in soil sample methods, broadly categorized into two types: (1) deriving spatially homogeneous subregions based on a single environmental variable60."),61."), especially for categorical variables such as soil parent materials62."); and (2) employing multiple environmental variables in cluster analysis to create homogeneous subregions63."), often utilizing fuzzy clustering algorithms like FCM64."). In detail, the procedure of the method consists of four steps: (1) to employ the REDCAP method to mine the homogeneous subregions; (2) to select the set of influential environmental variables for SOC in each subregion; (3) to determine the number of training samples for each sub-region with Neyman allocation, (4) to select training samples using cLHS in each subregion and then merge them to obtain the training sample sets of the entire study area. The proposed PcLHS is essentially a partition sampling method designed to construct sample points that ensure sufficient coverage across the feature space, thereby maximizing the capture of variations in soil properties. *et al.* A partitioned conditioned Latin hypercube sampling method considering spatial heterogeneity in digital soil mapping.
